content:
emily: Heads-up: planning a quiet night-drop to publish 1.5.1-rc.0 for py/ts. Well push a short-lived dist-tag for partners and surface the deprecation note for @redwood/sdk-sync. Rolling in ~20m unless objections.
noah: fine. what's the dist-tag so CI can pin?
zara: propose `partners-rc-2103` to keep it short and unique. I'll update CHANGELOG and package.json `deprecated` fields.
emily: publish plan: 1) build wheels -> testpypi 2) npm pack + publish with `--tag partners-rc-2103` 3) set pip alias 4) run quick smoke + perf. Rollback on any 403, signer-mismatch, or >0.6% 5xx in first 5m.
samir: noted. If deploy-bot reports `signer-mismatch`, we'll need ops approval for key-override. ops-bot will flag it.
deploy-bot: [483501-483502] publish job started: py(jb_48350) / npm(nb_48350) :rocket:
noah: preflight checklist done: changelog, deprecated field, checksum signed, prow pin for e2e.
deploy-bot: [483502-483503] py -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_48350). sha256: 4f7b2a...
emily: starting npm publish now.
deploy-bot: [483503-483504] npm publish (nb_48350) FAILED: `EINTEGRITY` writing tarball (checksum mismatch). Logs show tar header ordering changed.
zara: argh, pack non-deterministic again. samir, can you repack with NODE=18 and retry?
samir: repacking with node:18 and regenerating shrinkwrap. added `pack-check` step to CI.
deploy-bot: [483504-483505] npm publish RESTARTED (nb_48350) -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> partners-rc-2103
emily: running smoke + perf now.
deploy-bot: [483505-483506] smoke-suite started (is_48350)
noah: watching metrics: 4m in: 0.09% 5xx, median latency +16ms. within rollback thresholds.
emily: marketing/comms: short tech blurb please, mention migration guide and 90-day removal window.
zara: draft: "1.5.1-rc.0 available to partners via dist-tag `partners-rc-2103`. Legacy sync package `@redwood/sdk-sync` deprecated; see migration guide https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Scheduled removal: 90 days."
ops-bot: policy note: dist-tags with TTL=24h; auto-clean scheduled unless extended. manual extension requires release manager.
samir: follow-ups captured: pin node 18 for `pack`, add pack checksum assertion, ensure dist-tag TTL job in release infra.
deploy-bot: [483506-4835014600] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_48350). No signer/auth issues.
emily: closing thread. summary: RC published with dist-tag partners-rc-2103, initial pack integrity hiccup fixed via node pin, smoke/perf within thresholds. Keeping tag 24h then promote to canary if no regressions. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
